_help: Hidden things to tap. Each tap shows the next line in 'lines' (it loops back to the first after the last one), and the game remembers where she got to. mapSpots: x, y = a point on the campus map (1071 x 1427 px, 0.5 m per px), radius = how close a tap must land in map px, walkTo = true if she walks to the nearest path first. locationSpots: per location id. emptyLines = what she says when nobody is waiting there; stageZones = tappable rectangles on the 192 x 288 location picture, rect = [x, y, width, height] from its top-left corner. Replace these default lines with your own inside jokes.

lines: The college buses, parked in a perfect row.

Somewhere in there is a seat with your name on it.
The basketball court. Nobody ever passes the ball.
Free period plan: sit here and pretend to watch the match.

Maybe after the birthday cake. Maybe.

Benches like this have heard a lot of gossip.
Little flowers by the path. Someone waters these every day.
Today they're blooming just for you.
